title: Report a scam
lede: Who to contact depends on what has happened. Pick the one that matches, and follow the steps in order.

1.title: I got it but did nothing
1.sub: No reply, no click, no money
1.headline: Report it so others get warned.

steps.what: Report the message on MAUCORS+ with a screenshot and the sender’s number or address.
Forward it to the real bank or company using the contact on their official website.
Once you’ve reported it, block the number and delete the message.

2.title: I clicked or typed in details
2.sub: Link opened, password or card entered
2.headline: Lock your accounts first, then report.

steps.what: If you entered card or banking details, call the number on the back of your card and ask them to block it.
Start with email and banking. Use a different password for each.
Report what you entered and on which site.

3.title: I sent money or shared a code
3.sub: OTP given, transfer or Juice payment made
3.headline: Call your bank now. Every minute counts.

steps.what: Call the number on your card. Ask them to freeze the account and try to recall the payment. Note the reference they give you.
Report the fraud. You can also make a statement at your nearest police station.
File a report on MAUCORS+ with your bank reference and screenshots.
If anyone is in immediate danger, call 999 or 112.
For blackmail or sextortion online. Keep every message, don’t reply and don’t pay.
Report the account on MAUCORS+ so it can be taken down.

situations: Clicked a link or entered details
Sent money or shared an OTP

contactFor.ccu: Fraud where money was lost, blackmail
contactFor.bank: Money sent, card or code shared
contactFor.fsc: Unlicensed investment schemes. Online portal only

bankLine: Number on the back of your card
beforeBody: Keep the originals. Don’t delete the chat or block the number until you’ve saved these.
checklist: Sender’s number, email or profile link
sourceNote: Checked in September 2026 against CERT-MU, MAUCORS, the Police and the FSC. Check the official sites if a number doesn’t connect.
